faqs.question: What is the minimum order for wholesale coffee?
faqs.answer: Wholesale orders from {brand} start at one case. Volume pricing applies from the second case, and a quote for larger standing orders is available on request.

faqs.question: How fresh is wholesale coffee when it arrives?
faqs.answer: Wholesale orders are roasted after the order is placed, not pulled from stock. Each bag carries its roast date so you can rotate inventory.

faqs.question: Can {title} be supplied on a recurring schedule?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cafes and offices can set a weekly or fortnightly schedule, and quantities can be changed before each roast day.

faqs.question: How is decaf coffee made?
faqs.answer: Decaf is made by removing caffeine from green coffee before roasting. {title} uses a water process, which removes caffeine without chemical solvents.

faqs.question: Is decaf coffee completely caffeine free?
faqs.answer: No. Decaffeination removes most of the caffeine but a small amount remains in every cup.

faqs.question: Does decaf taste different from regular coffee?
faqs.answer: Slightly. Decaffeination changes how the bean roasts, so decaf is usually a little milder. A good decaf still shows the character of its origin.

faqs.question: What makes a coffee an espresso roast?
faqs.answer: An espresso roast is developed a little longer so it extracts evenly under pressure and holds up in milk. Any coffee can be brewed as espresso, but these are roasted for it.

faqs.question: Can {title} be used for drip or pour over?
faqs.answer: Yes. It will taste fuller and less bright than a light roast, which many people prefer for drip.

faqs.question: What grind size is right for espresso?
faqs.answer: Fine, close to table salt, then adjusted until a double shot takes roughly 25 to 30 seconds. Grind fresh for each shot if you can.

faqs.question: What does single origin mean?
faqs.answer: Single origin coffee comes from one country, region or farm instead of a blend. It shows the flavors specific to where it was grown.

faqs.question: How should {title} be brewed?
faqs.answer: Pour over or another filter method shows the most detail. Use water just off the boil and a medium grind, then adjust to taste.

faqs.question: How long does roasted coffee stay fresh?
faqs.answer: Whole bean coffee is at its best in the first few weeks after roasting. Keep it in the sealed bag, away from heat and light, and grind just before brewing.
